datasets.name: why
queryLines:
WITH pick AS (
  SELECT g.id, g.value_cents, t.title, t.price_cents AS sold_cents
  FROM secondhand.core.guarded_number g
  JOIN secondhand.market.comp t ON t.comp_id = g.item_id
  WHERE g.metric = 'valuation.model.q50' AND g.state = 'shown' AND g.data = 'dataset:stockx_2019'
  ORDER BY g.id
  LIMIT 12
)
SELECT concat(replace(p.title, '-', ' '), ': our price $', format_number(p.value_cents / 100, 0), ', sold for $', format_number(p.sold_cents / 100, 0)) AS price,
       replace(b.title, '-', ' ') AS basis_title, w.basis_price_cents / 100.0 AS basis_price, date_format(b.at, 'MMM d, yyyy') AS basis_at, b.at AS basis_ts,
       w.source_url, 'StockX' AS page, CASE WHEN w.equal THEN 'Yes' WHEN w.equal IS NULL THEN 'Not checked' ELSE 'No' END AS rebuilt
FROM pick p, LATERAL why(p.id) w
LEFT JOIN secondhand.market.comp b ON b.comp_id = w.basis_id
ORDER BY price, basis_ts DESC

datasets.name: stats
datasets.displayName: Every headline figure with its count
queryLines:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT `Price from` AS price_from, MEASURE(`Within 20 percent`) AS within_20,
         MEASURE(`Range held the sale`) AS range_held, MEASURE(`Estimates shown`) AS shown
  FROM valuation_metrics
  GROUP BY ALL
), c AS (
  SELECT sum(shown_with_citation) AS cited, sum(shown_numbers) AS shown FROM citation_coverage WHERE data <> 'synthetic'
), r AS (
  SELECT count_if(equal) AS equal_cases, count(*) AS cases FROM recompute_check
), l AS (
  SELECT count_if(has_owner_tag) AS locked, count(*) AS tables FROM policies_in_force
), n AS (
  SELECT count_if(NOT allow) AS refused, count(*) AS asked FROM never_automated
), h AS (
  SELECT count_if(state <> 'shown') AS hidden, count(*) AS made FROM secondhand.core.guarded_number
), f AS (
  SELECT sum(kept) AS kept, sum(modelled) AS allowed, count(*) AS sources FROM pipeline_funnel
), w AS (
  SELECT count_if(action = 'promote' AND version > 1) AS changed, count_if(action = 'hold') AS held,
         count_if(action = 'rollback') AS rolled_back, count(DISTINCT month) AS months
  FROM param_moves WHERE run_id = (SELECT max_by(run_id, month) FROM param_moves)
), a AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS readable FROM secondhand.governance.principal_map
  WHERE principal = current_user() AND user_id NOT IN ('system', 'usr_backtest')
)
SELECT 'cited' AS stat, format_number(cited, 0) AS value_label, concat('of ', format_number(shown, 0), ' shown prices') AS sub_label FROM c
UNION ALL SELECT 'rebuilt', format_number(equal_cases, 0), concat('of ', format_number(cases, 0), ' checked') FROM r
UNION ALL SELECT CASE price_from WHEN 'Our price' THEN 'ours' WHEN 'Last sale' THEN 'last_sale' ELSE 'median_90' END,
       coalesce(concat(format_number(within_20 * 100, 1), '%'), 'Too few'), concat('of ', format_number(shown, 0), ' priced') FROM m
UNION ALL SELECT 'ours_range', coalesce(concat(format_number(range_held * 100, 1), '%'), 'Too few'), concat('of ', format_number(shown, 0), ' ranges') FROM m WHERE price_from = 'Our price'
UNION ALL SELECT 'locked', format_number(locked, 0), concat('of ', format_number(tables, 0), ' tables') FROM l
UNION ALL SELECT 'refused', format_number(refused, 0), concat('of ', format_number(asked, 0), ' asked') FROM n
UNION ALL SELECT 'held_back', format_number(hidden, 0), concat('of ', format_number(made, 0), ' prices made') FROM h
UNION ALL SELECT 'kept', format_number(kept, 0), concat('public sales from ', sources, ' sources') FROM f
UNION ALL SELECT 'allowed', format_number(allowed, 0), concat('of ', format_number(kept, 0), ' allowed for the backtest') FROM f
UNION ALL SELECT 'changes', format_number(changed, 0), concat('in ', months, ' months of sales') FROM w
UNION ALL SELECT 'holds', format_number(held, 0), concat('of ', months, ' months tested and kept') FROM w
UNION ALL SELECT 'rollbacks', format_number(rolled_back, 0), 'undone the next month' FROM w
UNION ALL SELECT 'readable', format_number(readable, 0), 'besides system and backtest rows' FROM a

datasets.name: price_band
datasets.displayName: Price accuracy by sale price, from the metric view
queryLines:
SELECT substr(`Sale price band`, 4) AS band, `Sale price band` AS band_order, `Price from` AS price_from,
       1 - MEASURE(`Within 20 percent`) AS missed, MEASURE(`Estimates shown`) AS shown, MEASURE(`Sales tested`) AS tested
FROM valuation_metrics
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY band_order, price_from

datasets.name: price_range
datasets.displayName: Ranges that held the sale, from the metric view
queryLines:
SELECT `Price from` AS price_from, MEASURE(`Range held the sale`) AS range_held, MEASURE(`Estimates shown`) AS shown
FROM valuation_metrics
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY range_held DESC

datasets.name: held_back
queryLines:
SELECT CASE hide_reason WHEN 'too_few' THEN 'Too few sales' WHEN 'too_wide' THEN 'Sales too far apart'
                        WHEN 'source_gap' THEN 'A site could not be read' WHEN 'stale' THEN 'Sales too old'
                        ELSE replace(hide_reason, '_', ' ') END AS reason,
       CASE WHEN data = 'dataset:stockx_2019' THEN 'StockX 2019 backtest' WHEN data LIKE 'dataset:%' THEN concat(replace(substr(data, 9), '_', ' '), ' backtest') ELSE concat(data, ' items') END AS data_label,
       sum(count) AS held
FROM hidden_numbers
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY held DESC

datasets.name: price_week
datasets.displayName: Price accuracy by week, from the metric view
queryLines:
SELECT `Price from` AS price_from, `Week` AS week,
       MEASURE(`Within 20 percent`) AS within_20, MEASURE(`Estimates shown`) AS shown
FROM valuation_metrics
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY week

datasets.name: weight
datasets.displayName: The half-life in force each month
queryLines:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT * FROM param_moves
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT max_by(run_id, month) FROM param_moves)
), v AS (
  SELECT version, first(value) AS value FROM m WHERE action = 'propose' GROUP BY version
), months AS (
  SELECT month, max(champion_version) AS champion,
         count_if(action = 'promote' AND version > 1) AS changed,
         count_if(action = 'hold') AS held, count_if(action = 'rollback') AS rolled_back
  FROM m GROUP BY month
)
SELECT o.month, v.value AS half_life_days, o.changed, o.held, o.rolled_back
FROM months o JOIN v ON v.version = o.champion
UNION ALL
SELECT add_months(min(m.month), -1), first(v.value), 0, 0, 0
FROM m JOIN v ON v.version = 1
ORDER BY month

datasets.name: weight_change
queryLines:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT * FROM param_moves
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT max_by(run_id, month) FROM param_moves)
), v AS (
  SELECT version, first(value) AS value FROM m WHERE action = 'propose' GROUP BY version
)
SELECT date_format(c.month, 'MMM yyyy') AS month,
       concat(CASE c.action WHEN 'promote' THEN '' ELSE 'Rolled back: ' END, format_number(f.value, 0), ' days to ', format_number(c.value, 0), ' days') AS what,
       concat('+', format_number(c.diff * 100, 2), ' points, noise ', format_number(c.noise * 100, 2)) AS evidence
FROM m c
LEFT JOIN v f ON f.version = c.version - 1
WHERE (c.action = 'promote' AND c.version > 1) OR c.action = 'rollback'
ORDER BY c.month

datasets.name: guard
queryLines:
SELECT format_number(violations_now, 0) AS value_label, concat('checked ', date_format(last_checked_at, 'MMM d, h:mm a')) AS sub_label
FROM guard_status

datasets.name: isolation
queryLines:
SELECT concat(schema_name, '.', table_name) AS table_label,
       CASE WHEN has_owner_tag THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS locked,
       CASE WHEN has_owner_tag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS locked_count,
       coalesce(nullif(array_join(masked_columns, ', '), ''), 'None') AS masked,
       replace(retention_class, '_', ' ') AS kept_for
FROM policies_in_force
ORDER BY schema_name, table_name

datasets.name: never
queryLines:
SELECT CASE kind WHEN 'move_off_site' THEN 'Move a deal off the site'
                 WHEN 'refund' THEN 'Send a refund'
                 WHEN 'payment' THEN 'Take or send a payment'
                 WHEN 'complete_purchase' THEN 'Complete a purchase'
                 ELSE replace(kind, '_', ' ') END AS action_label,
       count(*) AS asked, count_if(NOT allow) AS refused
FROM never_automated
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: sources
queryLines:
SELECT replace(source, '_', ' ') AS source, kept, modelled, first_at, last_at
FROM pipeline_funnel
ORDER BY kept DESC
